extracted_information: The mod.info file is a simple text file used by Project Zomboid mods. It defines various aspects for the game to detect and load the mod correctly. It must be placed within the mod folder, ideally in the versioning folders for better organization. While technically all parameters are listed as optional, excluding the 'id' and 'name' parameters may cause the mod to break or not be available. The file name should be in full lowercase for compatibility with Linux and macOS operating systems. It can be edited with any text editor.

specifications.location: Within the mod folder (ideally versioning folders)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Defines the displayed name for your mod in the game's mod manager.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The mod ID used in a mod list of the user or servers to activate your mod.
parameters.notes: Must be unique across all mods.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Name of the author(s) of the mod.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of your mod, which shows up in the mod manager.
parameters.notes: It's possible to use ISRichTextPanel tags.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Show a URL link in the mod manager on the page of your mod for users to click on to open in browser. Can be used for donation links.

parameters.name: poster
parameters.description: Image which will show up in the mod manager as the mod image.
parameters.notes: Multiple posters can be used; the first one is the main poster. Additional posters appear in a list. Can be within subfolders (e.g., media/image.png).

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description: Image used in the mod manager next to the name of the mod in the list of available mods.
parameters.notes: This image will be small. Can use the poster as the icon. Can be within subfolders (e.g., media/image.png).

parameters.name: require
parameters.description: Mods required to run this mod.

parameters.name: incompatible
parameters.description: Mods that cannot be enabled at the same time as this mod.
parameters.notes: When enabled, the other mods become unselectable, and this mod becomes unselectable if incompatible mods are enabled.

parameters.name: loadModAfter
parameters.description: Loads the mod only after the set of mods listed.

parameters.name: loadModBefore
parameters.description: Loads the mod before the set of mods listed.

parameters.name: pack
parameters.description: Name of packs that need to be loaded by the game.

parameters.name: tiledef
parameters.description: Name of the tiledef with its ID that are added by the mod.
parameters.notes: Refer to 'Tiledefs used by mods' for available IDs to reduce incompatibility chance.

parameters.name: versionMin
parameters.description: The minimum version of the game the mod can be used on.

parameters.name: versionMax
parameters.description: The maximum version of the game the mod can be used on.
